snippet: Dear Cary, We appreciate your interest in the Lead Python Developer - 30262 position at Farmers Insurance. Unfortunately, we have chosen to move forward in the hiring process with other candidates
body_text:
Dear Cary,

 We appreciate your interest in the Lead Python Developer - 30262 position at Farmers Insurance. Unfortunately, we have chosen to move forward in the hiring process with other candidates whose qualifications and/or experience more closely match this position.

 Even though it did not work out this time, we would still encourage you to continue to pursue a new career with Farmers Insurance. For a list of current openings and to apply online, please visit our website at https://www.farmers.com/careers/corporate/. Be sure to set up a job alert since the list of opportunities is always changing.

 We value your feedback and would appreciate it if you could take a moment to complete our short, confidential  survey  about your experience with us. 

 Please note that this e-mail only pertains to position Lead Python Developer - 30262. If you have applied for other positions with us, you may still be in consideration for those positions.

 Thank you for your interest in joining the Farmers Insurance team. We hope we have the opportunity to consider you for other positions in the near future.

With kind regards,

Farmers Insurance Talent Acquisition
